title: Viva Vacation Villa! Walk to South Mountain Park!
description:
Spacious custom home in Phoenix' upscale Ahwatukee neighborhood. Quiet street within the Equestrian Estates, yet just 15-20 min. to Sky Harbor Airport, downtown Phoenix & all East Valley cities. Property has mountain views, new putting green, pool & toys, 3 TVs. Sleep up to 16 with room to roam! 5 bedrooms + loft, 4 baths, 4400 sq. ft, 15 beds + 1 inflatable. Great restaurants & shopping nearby. Easy access to I-10 freeway. Ideal for a family, or large group.

 The space 
Beautiful setting and mountain views, new 6-hole putting green, games (corn hole, ping pong)... All TV's have full YouTubeTV subscription with NFL Ticket added. You may not want to leave the house!
Close to Tempe & Chandler, 20 minutes to downtown Phoenix, Scottsdale, Gilbert & Mesa.
House has 4420 sq.ft., spacious open living areas, front living room, formal dining, large family room off the fully equipped kitchen, large covered patio overlooking landscaped backyard and pool. 
5 bedrooms and 4 full bathrooms. 4 bedrooms, 3 baths in main house, plus large 5th bedroom with separate entrance off the upper deck with an additional full bathroom. 

Downstairs:
Bedroom 1: king size bed, futon, ensuite bathroom
Bedroom 2: queen sized bed (only room that has a single bed)
Bedroom 3: one queen bed, 1 bunk bed (2 twins)
Hallway bathroom

Upstairs:
Bedroom 4: king bed, 2 twin stackable beds, ensuite bathroom
Loft: trundle with 2 twin beds
Bedroom 5: 2 queen beds and 1 bunk bed (2 twins), ensuite bathroom.

Total of 14 beds + futon + one available queen inflatable mattress. 

Note that of the 15 beds, only 10 will be prepared for guests (the trundle beds in the loft area, and stacked twins in upstairs master will only be prepared upon request when guest count warrants). Additional inflatable available upon request.

PLEASE NOTE, THE POOL IS NOT HEATED IN THE WINTER (the cost would be prohibitive) AND IS TOO COLD TO SWIM FOR MOST FROM NOVEMBER THROUGH APRIL

 Guest access 
Guests will have the entire property. NOTE: for 4 or fewer guests, the guest suite or 5th bedroom off the upper deck will be closed off.

 Other things to note 
No parties or events allowed. Only the guests on the reservation are allowed on the property. Additional daytime guests allowed only with a host's written permission.
Interim Cleaning: Any stay over 3 weeks will require an interim cleaning midstay, or after 2 weeks. Cost of additional cleanings to be shared by guests at 50% (we will pay half)
Pool is not enclosed, therefore the backyard is not safe for little ones. When booking, guests must acknowledge this awareness and state that adults will take responsibility and make sure children under 6 are not allowed in the backyard unless strictly supervised by adults at all times. PLEASE UNDERSTAND THAT THIS DISCLAIMER IS REQUIRED BY OUR INSURANCE.
Strong internet and full Youtube TV subscription with NFL ticket added. Three smart TVs can also stream your favorite shows with your own accounts.
amenities: Clothing storage: walk-in closet, closet, and dresser
Exercise equipment: free weights, yoga mat, workout bench
Free driveway parking on premises – 5 spaces
